messages:
michael: Kicking off telemetry-gated rollout for model-catalog:v3.2. Canaries: 5% NA, 5% EU. Fallback order updated to v3.1 -> v2.9 -> small-quant. Enterprise pin list unchanged. Change window 18:00-02:00 UTC. Ping if any blockers.

sarah: Thanks. I added the observability widgets on Console and the p95/error dashboards. Will we reshuffle fallback automatically if latency drifts? :thinking_face: 

michael: Yes — telemetry gate rules: p95 increase >150ms AND error rate increase >0.5% sustained for 5m triggers a fallback reshuffle. Config preview: ```gate:{"p95_ms":150,"err_pct":0.5,"duration_s":300,"action":"reshuffle"}```. We also have a 2m buffer before reshuffle to collect traces.

ramon: Ready to start canary. @deploy-bot, please kick it off.

deploy-bot: DeployBot: Initiating canary rollout for model-catalog:v3.2 -> 5% NA, 5% EU. Canary ID 20240312-1. Status: queued. :rocket: 

ops-jen: I'll monitor infra metrics (GPU mem, latency, queue depth). On-call: @alexa tonight.

alexa: I'm watching. If the telemetry gate trips, do we auto-reshuffle immediately or alert-first?

michael: Auto-reshuffle but with that 2m freeze window. Auto-reshuffle only adjusts fallback ordering within the same priority ladder. Full rollback (reverting to v3.1 everywhere) requires manual approval by eng-releases leads.

qa-labs: Quick check — running evals (prompt-set-3) against the canary to catch hallucination regressions. Uploading results -> https://internal.s3/redwood/v3.2-canary-eval.json

ramon: DeployBot: Canary nodes are warming: 1/10 warmed, 0 errors so far.

deploy-bot: DeployBot: Canary traffic now at 5%. Telemetry stream: https://console.redwood/telemetry/streams/20240312-1

sarah: Seeing a small p95 bump to ~60ms in NA, within baseline. No error spike.

michael: Good. Reminder: enterprise-customer pin CLI: `rictl pin --customer 12345 --model v3.1` — use if a specific account needs to be pinned mid-rollout.

alexa: Manual rollback runbook sketch (if we need it): 1) Drain canary nodes, 2) Change catalog priority to prefer v3.1, 3) Revert model-catalog config in git and open PR rollback, 4) Open incident, notify CS & PM, 5) Coordinate infra scale. I'll own steps 1-2.

ops-jen: If you need me for step 3 I'll apply the git revert and coordinate deployment to ensure config sync.

ramon: Note on reshuffle behavior: new logic prefers variants with less quantization when latency is similar to avoid quality regressions; tie-breaker is model fidelity metric.

michael: Also enable extended KV cache metrics for 2h post-cutover: `enable_kv_metrics=true` (temp flag). Helps diagnose any cache-related latency regressions.

deploy-bot: DeployBot: Canary healthy at 5% for 12m. Telemetry gate not tripped. :white_check_mark:

qa-labs: Evals look OK — hallucination delta <0.2% vs v3.1 on our test prompts.

sarah: Plan to bump to 20% in 30m if no issues. Will post another status before the bump.

michael: Acknowledged. Tagging PM and CS for visibility: @pm-oliver @cs-lead — short note in release notes: 'v3.2 enablement: telemetry-gated canary, fallback-reshuffle logic, KV metrics toggle.'

ops-jen: Temporary alert rule added: if fallback reshuffles occur >1 times in 1h, put rollout into quiet mode and hold further traffic increases.

alexa: Noted. If anything trips, call #incidents immediately and escalate.

michael: Thanks team. Will update runbook with explicit rollback commands and add a snippet for quick pins. :thumbsup:
